name: TRIPPEDD Production Studios Open-Source Production Stack
principle: Every production capability must resolve to a real executable, library, service, project format, generated artifact, or explicit human gate. No fake AVAILABLE state.

episodeCuts.sharedEvidencePolicy: Both cuts consume the same physical-source evidence model; editorial interpretation remains separate.

architecture.cachePolicy: Content-addressed deterministic artifacts are immutable and reusable across execution backends.
architecture.failurePolicy: Independent tasks retry without invalidating successful artifacts; assembly begins only after manifest validation.
architecture.provenance: Every generated media artifact records source evidence, generator identity, toolchain versions, and checksums.
architecture.fallbackPolicy: Optional tools improve analysis or processing but never replace the deterministic FFmpeg/OTIO path without a verified fallback.
